outcome: Give repository users and agents one CyberAlchemy-v2-owned, fail-closed entry point that classifies every objective, names its authority and evidence inputs, and prevents an unavailable capability from silently falling back to another routing system.
scope: Classify repository objectives, constrain initial context, expose current capability gaps, and bind native work to one declared CyberAlchemy-v2 route without granting downstream lifecycle or effect authority.
exclusions: deleting or deprecating public subsystem source code
claiming that route availability proves runtime realization
admitting the DomainSpec profile or generated system ontology
authorizing implementation, publication, deployment, or external effects without an exact user or owner decision
using a repository-local or global capability as a routing fallback

owner_routes.owner: Owner of the selected repository objective

owner.value: CyberAlchemy v2 product and agent-routing owners

revision_history.change: Created the CyberAlchemy-v2-owned repository entry router and removed direct public-subsystem capability routing from root instructions.
revision_history.owner_route: CyberAlchemy v2 product owner plus agent-routing owner

revision_history.change: Required every ontology-related request to pass the exact registered ontology-runtime preflight while preserving one objective route and separate effect authority.
revision_history.owner_route: CyberAlchemy v2 product, agent-routing, and Ontology Runtime owners

revision_history.change: Suspended mandatory ontology-runtime gating pending a governance-selected Rust kernel with selector-level dependency relevance.
revision_history.owner_route: CyberAlchemy v2 product, agent-routing, and governance-model owners

challenge_route: Challenge canonical meaning through CA2-ROUTE-DEFINITIONS, route behavior through CA2-ROUTE-VALIDATE, and activation or effect claims through CA2-ROUTE-GOVERNANCE.
claim_limit: Owner-directed local routing behavior and candidate D65 construction evidence only; no DomainSpec or system-ontology admission, complete capability realization, conformance, publication, release, deployment, or external effect.
